conviction_note: Measured from close 2026-11-25 to the close of the half-day session on 2026-11-27. abs_move 7.0 comes from XYF's own last four prints (-15.7%, +2.0%, about +10% and about +3%; median absolute about 6%), 86% realised vol and a thin half day. p_up is 45: the largest peer (Qfin, 11-24 after close) reported Q3 volume -22% QoQ, 30-day collections down from 88.1% to 86.0%, and guided Q4 volume about -20%, and the sector fell 8-15% on 11-25 while XYF barely moved. Pulling p_up toward 50: the read-through is a proxy, no consensus bar exists, a possible renewal of the buyback that lapses 11-30 is a positive, and the stock trades near 0.2x book. The findings sum is -2.0 and the scaled number is -0.7; they agree in sign, and the gap is the proxy discount on the peer read-through.

All finding sizes are capped small because no bar is sourced.

FINRA settlement 2026-09-15: 84,602 shares, about 1.0 days to cover (https://equibles.com/stocks/xyf/short-interest). Fintel shows 86,510 shares and 1.85 days, undated (https://fintel.io/ss/us/XYF). MarketBeat for 2026-05-29: 219,436 shares, 0.82% of float. Not a crowded short. Yahoo daily bars show 11-24 at 5.23 and 11-25 at 5.20 intraday on only 32.9k shares, the same day QFIN fell about 15%, FINV about 11%, LX 11.7% and YRD about 8%. findings.finding: Peer read-through from Qfin's Q3 2026 release (11-24 after close; Qfin is the largest US-listed peer). Volume fell 21.9% QoQ to RMB49.5bn. The 30-day collection rate fell to 86.0% from 88.1% in Q2 2026, and Day-1 delinquency rose to 5.8% from 5.6%. Management cited a nationwide regulatory campaign that disrupted the collections industry, more cautious funding partners after a late-June industry event, and Q4 volume down about 20% QoQ, with caution into 1H27. XYF's Q2 delinquency improvement (31-60d 2.61% to 1.73%) was credited on its call to 'additional resources deployed in collections'. That is exactly the channel Qfin says worsened in Q3. XYF's Q3 volume and its next guide face the same funding squeeze.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: XYF's largest reaction in the four prints sourced was on a guide. The Q3 2025 release (2025-11-20, 4:50pm ET) guided Q4 2025 originations to RMB21-23bn, about -32% QoQ, and the stock fell from 9.11 to 7.68 (-15.7%) on 11-21. The Q2 2026 release (bmo 2026-08-24) gave no guide, showed improving delinquency and drew +2.0% (5.39 to 5.50). Yahoo daily bars: https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/XYF?range=2y&interval=1d
findings.why_not_priced: On 11-25 the peers re-priced on this release: QFIN about -15%, FINV about -11%, LX -11.7%, YRD about -8% (https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-lexinfintech-holdings-lx-stock-down-11-69-today-47156/). XYF traded 5.23 to 5.20 on 32.9k shares. Had its holders priced the read-through, XYF would show a sympathy gap like the others. The counter-reading is that XYF already de-rated a year ago (-70% volume YoY) and now trades on book value and yield, not volume. That argument is why this is sized at -2.5 and not at the peers' -10.
findings.independence: Qfin Q2 2026 release for the 88.1% collection-rate and 5.6% Day-1 comparison: https://finviz.com/news/385508/qfin-holdings-announces-second-quarter-and-interim-2026-unaudited-financial-results-and-declares-semi-annual-dividend (2026-08-25). Qfin's Q4 guide and stock reaction: https://longbridge.com/en/news/306731245 (2026-11-25). Lexin's Q2 call expected Q3 originations down significantly and risk indicators rising sequentially: https://ng.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/earnings-call-transcript-lexin-q2-2026-profit-falls-as-q3-loss-looms-93CH-2680370. findings.finding: XYF's $100m buyback expires 2026-11-30, three days after this release, with about $35.5m unused at 2026-08-14. That is roughly 18% of a market cap near $190m. The Q3 release is the last scheduled communication before expiry, so it is the natural place to extend or replace the program. On the Q2 call the CFO gave no new plan ('doing all we can under the normal buyback circumstances and rules').
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The current $100m program was announced with the Q1 2025 results (May 2025). XYF closed 15.00 to 15.84 (+5.6%) that day and +9.8% the next (Yahoo bars; announcement: https://www.itiger.com/news/2536630066). XYF also bought 6.35m ADS from a major holder in December 2024 (https://www.nasdaq.com/articles/x-financial-repurchase-487-mln-shares-its-main-shareholder).
findings.why_not_priced: The stock has held 5.2-5.5 since August with no buyback news. A market expecting renewal would show the stock firm into the date, and it did hold while peers fell on 11-25. So part of this may already be in the price, and the outcome is binary and unknown. Sized small and positive, with a downside tail if the program is allowed to lapse.
findings.independence: Q2 call transcript, CFO on returns and the Nov 30 expiry: https://www.webull.com/news/15460662063678464 (2026-08-24). Q1 2026 release showing $39.8m remaining: https://www.barchart.com/story/news/2161520/x-financial-reports-first-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results. Both are company documents of the same program.

findings.finding: Q2 2026 net income of RMB47.0m carried two items that will not repeat. One was a reversal of earlier guarantee reserves, which the CFO said is not 'a new lower run rate for the provision'. The other was a RMB95.3m provision for credit losses on deposits, against RMB0.7m a year earlier, which writes off guarantee money one funding institution has not returned; management said it may still come back. So Q3 net income against Q2 depends on two below-the-line items. A recovery of the guarantee money would reverse up to RMB95m; a normal guarantee provision would cut Q3 profit.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no separate history for these items. In Q2 2026 net income rose 23.8% QoQ with both items in it, and the stock moved +2.0%.
findings.why_not_priced: The release reports only the line items. The non-recurring nature of each sits in the call transcript, and no consensus exists to absorb it. The two items push in opposite directions, so the net size is near zero with a wide band.
findings.independence: The RMB95.3m line appears in the Q2 release income statement: https://finviz.com/news/384651/x-financial-reports-second-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results. That is the same company disclosure, not independent.

Its print and Q4 commentary will be the last sector read before XYF reports; the direction is unknown now.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: XYF did not follow the 11-25 sector selloff on the Qfin print (-0.6% against peers -8% to -15%). Its sensitivity to peer prints looks low.
findings.why_not_priced: The release is not out yet. Sized at 0 because its sign cannot be known before it lands; it is filed so the judges see a second sector catalyst inside the window.

findings.finding: Industry structure is still worsening for mid-tier facilitators. Bank partner lists shrank: Jilin Yillion Bank went from 56 acquisition partners in November 2024 to 10 in July 2026. Small and mid-sized platforms are described as likely to be acquired or exit. Online-marketing curbs took effect 2026-09-30, inside XYF's Q4. This bears on XYF's funding capacity and any Q4 guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: XYF's regulatory warnings have repeated in every 2026 release (Q4 2025, Q1 2026, Q2 2026), and the stock has drawn +2% to +10% on those prints. The market has looked through the generic regulatory language.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: this is public macro and regulatory context, and XYF names no partner. Filed small as a proxy.

baseline_tension: There is no skew to agree or disagree with. The negative peer read-through runs against XYF's +6.6% 20-day run-up and its flat tape on 11-25 while peers fell. That holds two readings: either the read-through is unpriced in XYF, or holders treat it as a book-value and yield name. That ambiguity is why p_up sits at 45 and not lower.
